label: $SERVICE_NAME for $ARCH
description: A service to deploy EdgeLake with Open Horizon

userInput.name: INIT_TYPE
userInput.label: Basic deployment settings Container image, deployment type -> prod: run AnyLog instance -> bash: run shell interface with AnyLog installed and params set

userInput.name: IMAGE
userInput.label: AnyLog image

userInput.name: DEPLOYMENTS_REPO
userInput.label: Github repo to use for configuring / deploying node

userInput.name: DEPLOYMENTS_BRANCH
userInput.label: Branch associated with git repo

userInput.name: NODE_TYPE
userInput.label: Core node configuration - required for all deployments Configuration based deploymnet node deployment type Node Types:   generic: sandbox with only network configured   master: "blockchain" emulator   operator: agent dedicated to storing data   query: agent dedicated to querying data (enable system_query logical database)   publisher: agent used to distribute data   master-operator: a combination of master and operator on a single agent   master-publisher: a combination of master and publisher on a single agent

userInput.name: NODE_NAME
userInput.label: Name of the AnyLog instance

userInput.name: COMPANY_NAME
userInput.label: Owner of the AnyLog instance

userInput.name: ANYLOG_SERVER_PORT
userInput.label: Port address used by AnyLog's TCP protocol to communicate with other nodes in the network

userInput.name: ANYLOG_REST_PORT
userInput.label: Port address used by AnyLog's REST protocol

userInput.name: ANYLOG_BROKER_PORT
userInput.label: Port value to be used as an MQTT broker, or some other third-party broker

userInput.name: DB_TYPE
userInput.label: Physical database type (sqlite, psql)

userInput.name: DB_IP
userInput.label: Database IP address

userInput.name: DB_PORT
userInput.label: Database port number

userInput.name: AUTOCOMMIT
userInput.label: Whether to set autocommit data

userInput.name: BLOBS_STORAGE
userInput.label: Enable external blob storage

userInput.name: BLOB_STORAGE_TYPE
userInput.label: Storage backend type - Supported: mongo, s3, akave, minio

userInput.name: BLOB_STORAGE_IP
userInput.label: Storage endpoint (MongoDB or object storage endpoint)

userInput.name: BLOB_STORAGE_PORT
userInput.label: Storage port (used mainly for MongoDB)

userInput.name: SYSTEM_QUERY
userInput.label: Whether to start system_query logical database

userInput.name: SYSTEM_QUERY_DB
userInput.label: Database type used for system_query logical database

userInput.name: MEMORY
userInput.label: Run system_query using in-memory SQLite. If set to false, will use pre-set database type

userInput.name: LEDGER_CONN
userInput.label: TCP connection information for Master Node

userInput.name: BLOCKCHAIN_SYNC
userInput.label: How often to sync from blockchain

userInput.name: BLOCKCHAIN_SOURCE
userInput.label: Source of where the blockchain data is coming from (master, optimism)

userInput.name: BLOCKCHAIN_DESTINATION
userInput.label: Where the local copy of the blockchain will be stored

userInput.name: CLUSTER_NAME
userInput.label: Owner of the cluster

userInput.name: DEFAULT_DBMS
userInput.label: Logical database name

userInput.name: NODE_MONITORING
userInput.label: Data ingestion protocols (MQTT, OPC-UA, video streaming, monitoring) Whether to monitor the node or not

userInput.name: STORE_MONITORING
userInput.label: Store monitoring in Operator node(s)

userInput.name: SYSLOG_MONITORING
userInput.label: Accept syslog data from local (Message broker required)

userInput.name: DOCKER_MONITORING
userInput.label: Docker Monitoring

userInput.name: ENABLE_VIDEO_STREAMING
userInput.label: Enable or disable video streaming. true = stream video, false = do not stream

userInput.name: VIDEO_URL
userInput.label: URL of the video to stream. Can be a YouTube link or other video source.

userInput.name: VIDEO_PORT
userInput.label: Port on which the video streaming server will run.

userInput.name: VIDEO_NAME
userInput.label: Name of the video stream or service identifier.

userInput.name: ENABLE_DETECTIONS
userInput.label: Enable or disable object detections (like YOLO detections) on the video. true = enable detections, false = disable

userInput.name: YOLO_MODEL_PORT
userInput.label: Port on which the YOLO model server will run for object detection.

userInput.name: ENABLE_MQTT
userInput.label: Whether to enable the default MQTT process

userInput.name: MQTT_BROKER
userInput.label: IP address of MQTT broker

userInput.name: MQTT_PORT
userInput.label: Port associated with MQTT broker

userInput.name: MQTT_LOG
userInput.label: Whether to enable MQTT logging process

userInput.name: MSG_TOPIC
userInput.label: Topic to get data for

userInput.name: MSG_DBMS
userInput.label: Logical database name

userInput.name: MSG_TABLE
userInput.label: Table where to store data

userInput.name: MSG_TIMESTAMP_COLUMN
userInput.label: Timestamp column name

userInput.name: MSG_VALUE_COLUMN
userInput.label: Value column name

userInput.name: MSG_VALUE_COLUMN_TYPE
userInput.label: Column value type

userInput.name: ENABLE_OPCUA
userInput.label: Whether or not to enable to OPC-UA service

userInput.name: OPCUA_URL
userInput.label: OPC-UA URL address (ex. opcua.tcp:;//127.0.0.1:4840)

userInput.name: OPCUA_NODE
userInput.label: Node information the root is located in (ex. ns=2;s=DataSet)

userInput.name: OPCUA_FREQUENCY
userInput.label: How often to pull data from OPC-UA

userInput.name: ANYLOG_PATH
userInput.label: Fine-tuning for experienced users - safe to leave as defaults AnyLog Root Path

userInput.name: LOCAL_SCRIPTS
userInput.label: !local_scripts: ${ANYLOG_HOME}/deployment-scripts/scripts

userInput.name: TEST_DIR
userInput.label: !test_dir: ${ANYLOG_HOME}/deployment-scripts/test

userInput.name: IS_HIDDEN
userInput.label: hide blockchain policy - supports all node types except cluster / operator

userInput.name: DEPLOY_LOCAL_SCRIPT
userInput.label: Whether to automatically run a local (or personalized) script at the end of the process

userInput.name: LOCATION
userInput.label: Coordinates of the machine - used by Grafana to map the network

userInput.name: COUNTRY
userInput.label: Country where machine is located

userInput.name: STATE
userInput.label: State where machine is located

userInput.name: CITY
userInput.label: City where machine is located

userInput.name: CONFIG_NAME
userInput.label: Declare Policy name

userInput.name: ENABLE_DNS
userInput.label: Whether to enable DNS resolution

userInput.name: NIC_TYPE
userInput.label: NIC type used to resolve the internal IP address (ex. eth0, lo)

userInput.name: OVERLAY_IP
userInput.label: Overlay IP address - if set, will replace local IP address when connecting to network

userInput.name: EXTERNAL_DNS
userInput.label: External DNS resolution

userInput.name: DNS_DOMAIN
userInput.label: local DNS domain to append to hostname (ex. example.com)

userInput.name: DNS
userInput.label: Full path for machine's (local) DNS

userInput.name: TCP_BIND
userInput.label: Bind settings - a true value binds to a specific IP and Port (a false value binds to all IPs)

userInput.name: BROKER_BIND
userInput.label: Number of concurrent threads per connection protocol

userInput.name: BROKER_THREADS
userInput.label: Timeout in seconds for REST requests (0 = continuous)

userInput.name: REST_TIMEOUT
userInput.label: Reuse identical blobs using file hash

userInput.name: BLOBS_REUSE
userInput.label: Compress blobs before storage

userInput.name: BLOBS_COMPRESS
userInput.label: Folder for storing blobs locally

userInput.name: BLOBS_FOLDER
userInput.label: Leave empty to use default application path

userInput.name: BUCKET_GROUP
userInput.label: Logical bucket grouping

userInput.name: BUCKET_ID
userInput.label: Bucket identifier

userInput.name: BUCKET_REGION
userInput.label: Cloud region

userInput.name: MEMBER
userInput.label: Operator ID - autogenerated INT if not specified This is used to help keep a record of where data was originally stored

userInput.name: ENABLE_HA
userInput.label: Whether of not to enable HA against the cluster

userInput.name: START_DATE
userInput.label: How many days back to sync between nodes

userInput.name: OPERATOR_THREADS
userInput.label: How many threads to use in the operator process

userInput.name: COMPRESS_FILE
userInput.label: Compress JSON and SQL file(s) backup

userInput.name: WRITE_IMMEDIATE
userInput.label: When data comes in write to database immediately, as opposed to waiting for a full buffer

userInput.name: THRESHOLD_TIME
userInput.label: If buffer is not full, how long to wait until pushing data through

userInput.name: THRESHOLD_VOLUME
userInput.label: Buffer size to reach, at which point data is pushed through

userInput.name: QUERY_POOL
userInput.label: Number of parallel queries

userInput.name: LICENSE_KEY
userInput.label: Sensitive credentials - do not commit to version control will be updated to use sercets logic for both docker and k8s AnyLog License Key

userInput.name: DB_USER
userInput.label: Username for SQL database connection

userInput.name: DB_PASSWD
userInput.label: Password correlated to database user

userInput.name: BLOB_STORAGE_USER
userInput.label: Optional DB authentication

userInput.name: BLOB_STORAGE_PASSWORD
userInput.label: User associated with MQTT broker

userInput.name: MQTT_USER
userInput.label: Password associated with MQTT user

userInput.name: MQTT_PASSWD
userInput.label: Access credentials

userInput.name: BUCKET_SECRET_KEY
userInput.label: Companion UI application - deployed alongside the AnyLog node

userInput.name: ENABLE_REMOTE_GUI
userInput.label: Whether to enable Remote-GUI in deployment

userInput.name: REMOTE_GUI_TAG
userInput.label: Remote-GUI version Tag

userInput.name: REMOTE_GUI_NIC
userInput.label: NIC type to use for Remote-GUI - if not set, uses 127.0.0.1

userInput.name: REMOTE_GUI_FE
userInput.label: Remote GUI Frontend Port

userInput.name: REMOTE_GUI_BE
userInput.label: Remote GUI Backend Port

userInput.name: GRAFANA_URL
userInput.label: Grafana PATH to reference for Grafana connection
